planned.description: Tempo run, 5 km at threshold pace

daily_comment.summary: Strong tempo effort. 4:48/km for 5 km is a solid threshold session — flat profile with only 16m elevation kept the pace honest. This pace suggests a half-marathon potential around 1:42-1:45.
did_right: Maintained consistent pace throughout — 4:48/km is genuine threshold effort
Good distance for a tempo — not too long, not too short
to_improve: Consider structured warm-up and cool-down around tempo blocks
Would benefit from structured VO2max intervals instead of ad-hoc fast runs
